scope: Verified Slay the Spire 1 / Ironclad / Ascension 0 reference pack for Act 1. Strategy claims stay conditional; this file must not be used for Slay the Spire 2.

claims.statement: At Ascension 0, Ironclad starts with 80 maximum HP, Burning Blood, five Strikes, four Defends, and Bash; Burning Blood heals 6 HP after combat.
Pommel Strike costs 1 Energy, deals 9 damage, and draws 1 card; its upgrade deals 10 and draws 2.
Shrug It Off costs 1 Energy, gains 8 Block, and draws 1 card; its upgrade gains 11 Block and still draws 1 card.
Combust costs 1 Energy and, at the end of each player turn, causes the player to lose 1 HP and deals 5 damage to all enemies; its upgrade deals 7 damage.
Swift Potion draws 3 cards when used.
Normal Act 1 combat uses an easy pool for the first three monster encounters; the pool includes solo Cultist, solo Jaw Worm, two Louses, and small Slimes.

After the first three Act 1 normal encounters, the hard pool can include Blue Slaver, Red Slaver, Looter, Gremlin Gang, larger slime encounters, louse/fungi groups, and mixed thugs or wildlife encounters.
Cultist has 48–54 HP at base, begins with Incantation for 3 Ritual, then uses Dark Strike for 6 damage every turn.

Blue Slaver has 46–50 HP at base. Its Stab deals 12 damage; Rake deals 7 damage and applies 1 Weak. Its ordinary pattern is probabilistic, so current intent must be read rather than inferred from the previous turn alone.
Jaw Worm begins with Chomp for 11 damage at base; its other moves include Thrash for 7 damage plus 5 Block and Bellow for 3 Strength plus 6 Block.
The possible Act 1 Elites are Gremlin Nob, Lagavulin, and Sentries. Defeating an Elite yields a random relic in addition to 25–35 Gold and a card reward.
Gremlin Nob has 82–86 HP at base, gains Enrage when Skills are played, begins with Bellow, and then uses Skull Bash or Bull Rush according to its pattern.

Lagavulin has 109–111 HP at base and begins asleep in its Act 1 Elite encounter. Damaging it causes a stunned turn before it begins its Attack, Attack, Siphon Soul pattern; waiting three turns wakes it instead.

The Act 1 Sentries Elite consists of three Sentries. Sentries have Artifact 1; outer Sentries use Bolt then Beam, while the middle uses Beam then Bolt. Bolt adds Dazed cards to discard and Beam attacks for 9 damage at base.

Map rooms have distinct visual icon categories for monster, elite, event, merchant, rest site, treasure, and boss. Screen extraction must classify a node with sufficient confidence before risk-based path advice is issued.
claims.conditions: The distinct icon categories are factual; the confidence gate is VEDA's safety policy.
